'''Brian Terwilliger RTP''' is a [[Light]] constructed list titled '''RTP''', published by [[Brian Terwilliger]] on 22 January 2021 after he played it in the Team Albany GEMP League.<ref name="rtp">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1352496974591889409 Brian Terwilliger], X (22 January 2021). "Sure do! Just played it in the Team Albany Gemp League. Princess is ALwAYS rescued." Original JPEG: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008222904/https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EsUI1GNXYAAGCAa.jpg?format=jpg&name=orig Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
* '''Published:''' 22 January 2021
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif|label=Rescue The Princess}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open RTP Twigg LS 2021 TALeague.txt |Download]]
